entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 12490 of 2023

Applicant :- Sunita Singh
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Hari Krishna Verma,Atul Verma,Sanjeet Kumar Patel Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.

1. Heard Sri Atul Verma, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Anant Pratap Verma,
the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
508 of 2023, under Section 419, 420, 465, 468, 471, 120-B I.P.C. and Section 3/9 of U.P. Public Examinations Act, 1988, registered at Police Station Madiyaon, District Lucknow.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged by a Principal of a college on 24.09.2023, alleging that the applicant was appearing as a candidate in a competitive examination held by U.P. Subordinate Service Examination.

4. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is a 30 years old woman having no criminal history and she has a four years old daughter, who is suffering because of her incarceration..

entities.text: Sunita Singh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the bail, but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact the applicant is a woman having a four years old daughter suffering due to her incarceration and without making any observations which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

8. Let the applicant- Sunita Singh be released on bail in the aforesaid case, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Magistrate/Court concerned,
subject to the following conditions: -
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
(Subhash Vidyarthi,J.) Order Date :- 19.10.2023 Preeti.
